name: freewash
description: Free-roam WebGL game set in Washington Square Park, rendered as pixel art - walk or skate the Fifth Avenue promenade, the fountain plaza and the tree-lined walks, past Garibaldi, the chess corner, the dog run and the arch. Laid out to the real park's plan, with a full day-night cycle, fully synthesised sound and a ~180-strong crowd built to human measurements: adult proportions, shoulders that slope off a joint six centimetres under the acromion so everyone has a neck and a full-length arm, a waist narrower than the ribcage, skulls with a jaw and a nose and lids over the eyes, hair with a hairline, sleeves and belts and hands in pockets. Nobody stands to attention: standing still is a weight shift, a breath, a soft knee and hands against the thighs. Press F to talk to anyone: everyone has a name, a job and a taste in conversation, rapport is a five-tone flirting game, and numbers you win go in your phone. Nine sidequests around the park pay rep, and rep is charisma. Renders entirely in the browser via three.js/WebGL.

endpoints.play: Serve the game and open it in the browser
endpoints.serve: Start the static WebGL game server
